name: twist superman
description: A floor exercise where you lift your limbs off the ground and add a rotation, training the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Rotate your torso slightly to one side while holding the lift.
Return to the center, then rotate to the other side.
Lower down with control and keep your neck neutral.
